decisions.reason: Using the L–V spacing rhythm as a kerning benchmark does not change the locked Hero V geometry or its governing design rules.
The optical-spacing benchmark does not alter the second V's established vertical hierarchy; the separate hierarchy change in the same message is already represented.
Kerning the letter pairs does not change the second V's geometry; the separately requested second-V geometry options already have a same-message MODIFY.
The source changes spacing around the letterforms, not the E and L shapes, proportions, construction, or architectural design language.
The pair-spacing benchmark does not change the É accent's literal derivation from the Hero V terminal.
Optically balancing horizontal letter spacing does not alter the required shared peak alignment of the Hero V and É accent.
The kerning refinement leaves the locked terminal geometry and its Hero-V/É-accent sharing rule unchanged.
The spacing benchmark does not modify the obligation to explain the design rationale accompanying review rounds.
The optical-spacing decision does not resume or modify the deferred champagne material treatment.
